The '''Tarkenia system''' was located in the [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the beverage known as the [[Tarkenian Nightflower]].<ref name="RebelDawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Tarkenian Nightflower]]|system=Tarkenia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tarkenia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square Q-17.<ref name="EAOC" />
